question: Which nation recently became the 90th State Member of the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tuvalu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Tuvalu, one of the world’s smallest and most climate-vulnerable nations, has officially joined the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) as its 90th State Member.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• This membership strengthens Tuvalu’s environmental governance and global engagement in conservation efforts, especially concerning climate change.
 
• **Tuvalu, located in the Pacific Ocean, is a small nation comprising nine atolls and islands, with significant climate challenges like sea-level rise and coastal erosion.**
 
• **By joining the IUCN, Tuvalu gains access to global expertise, scientific research, and international advocacy for environmental concerns.**
 
• **The IUCN membership also opens strategic opportunities for Tuvalu, including collaborations with the Green Climate Fund and Global Environment Facility.**
 
• **Tuvalu will benefit from support on sustainable fisheries, marine protected areas, and climate adaptation innovations through IUCN partnerships.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tuvalu’s Climate Challenges**__

 __
 
• Sea-level rise threatens to submerge large parts of the country, while coastal erosion destroys habitats and reduces land area.
 
• Invasive species and climate change further exacerbate the nation’s vulnerability, impacting food security and freshwater availability.
 
 
 
• **IUCN’s Role**__
 
 
• The IUCN is a global network working on biodiversity conservation and sustainable development, providing technical support and advocacy for member nations.
 
• Its initiatives aim to support nations like Tuvalu in addressing environmental and climate challenges, enhancing their resilience and sustainability.
